field.name: brandingText
field.comment: The text displayed as the brand (empty: the name of the site)

field.name: brandingLogo
field.comment: The ID of the image displayed as the brand (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: brandingTransparentLogo
field.comment: The ID of the image displayed as the brand while the bar is transparent (0 or NULL: brandingLogo is kept)

field.name: includeBrandText
field.comment: true: brandingText is displayed as the brand; false or NULL: it isn't

field.name: includeBrandLogo
field.comment: true: brandingLogo is displayed as the brand; false or NULL: it isn't

field.name: includeTransparency
field.comment: true: the bar is transparent until the visitor scrolls, if the theme supports it; false or NULL: it always has a background

field.name: includeStickyNav
field.comment: true: the bar stays at the top while the visitor scrolls, if the theme supports it; false or NULL: it scrolls away

field.name: includeNavigation
field.comment: true: the pages of the site are displayed in the bar; false or NULL: they are left out

field.name: includeNavigationDropdowns
field.comment: true: the child pages are displayed in dropdown menus; false or NULL: only the top level pages are displayed

field.name: includeSearchInput
field.comment: true: a search box is displayed in the bar; false or NULL: it isn't

field.name: searchInputFormActionPageID
field.comment: The ID of the page that displays the results of the search (0 or NULL: the page holding the block)

field.name: includeSwitchLanguage
field.comment: true: the visitors are offered the languages of the site; false or NULL: they are not

field.name: ignorePermissions
field.comment: true: the pages that the visitor is not allowed to view are displayed too; false: they are left out
